@cjihrig Since the discussion in https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/42430 seems to be (presumably) taking longer than expected, can we merge this in the meantime? It's no longer just affecting my daily benchmark runs, but now also PRs that need to run the benchmark.
Yea, I think it's probably fine to merge. Sorry for the hold up.
Closing because https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/42746 has landed, and fixes the issue. Please re-open if I'm mistaken.

comments: It's also interesting that this wasn't picked up by CI.....

> It's also interesting that this wasn't picked up by CI.....

The first configuration runs successfully and the tests only run one configuration for each benchmark so that's why it passed:

```
misc/startup.js
misc/startup.js mode="process" script="benchmark/fixtures/require-builtins" dur=0.05: 14.094491103317608
```

The tests can't check every possible configuration, of course, so they are just a minimal smoke-test that catches completely broken benchmarks.
